name: Steel for Tomorrow
description: Dusan needs scrap to keep essential equipment running. Official deliveries are late, and the factory cannot wait for another inspection.
offerText: The factory needs scrap. Can you help?

stages.description: Find one piece of scrap. Check trash bins at night, before the morning cleanup.
Return to Irina Kovalenko with one piece of scrap for the factory.

_codex.narrativeIntent: Dusan needs metal because official shipments are diverted; he hides suspicion behind ordinary repair work.
implementationNotes: After completion Irina can discuss delayed factory parts.
